label: Linear observations
title: Under every linear observation, closure is decided by the kernel, and the richer kernels keep only the affine rules
kind: Exact audit of all eight linear rules as observations, with a coset refinement census
summary: Observations with the complement-pair kernel (rules 60, 102, and 90 on odd rings) reproduce the parity results exactly; rule 90 on even rings and rule 150 on rings divisible by 3 close only the 16 affine rules; history depth under those richer kernels reaches 4 within ring 12 and varies with ring size.
takeaway: The constant-complement-response criterion belongs to one kernel. Larger kernels in the linear family admit only affine rules, and their memory cost is no longer bounded by two steps.
